close_reason: fixed: before/after filter uses rfc3339_to_epoch_secs for epoch comparison
description: now_utc_string() emits .mmmZ format (e.g. 2025-12-31T00:00:00.123Z) for receivedAt on Email/set create. The before/after filter in email_matches_condition (tests/common/mod.rs lines 1884-1895) uses lexicographic string comparison. Because '.' (0x2E) < 'Z' (0x5A), a receivedAt of '2025-12-31T00:00:00.123Z' compares LESS THAN a filter boundary of '2025-12-31T00:00:00Z'. Result: (1) 'before: T' incorrectly includes emails timestamped at T+123ms; (2) 'after: T' incorrectly excludes emails timestamped at T+123ms. Any test that creates emails via Email/set (which uses now_utc_string()) and then queries with before/after boundaries will produce wrong results. The fix is to either normalize all receivedAt to the same format before comparison, or use rfc3339_to_epoch_secs for before/after comparisons.
title: before/after filter breaks with mixed .mmmZ vs Z receivedAt formats
